csv_scope_of_work: Airport consultants for professional airport planning and environmental services for the following projects at the Lake Chelan Airport/S10. Project include 1) Runway Alignment and potential extension 2) Removal and/or mitigation of obstructions 3) Land acquisition and relocation assistance 4) Hangar relocation and Taxiway improvements 5) Relocation of roads, fuel station and utilities to facilitate implementation of ALP 6) Conduct overview of environmental conditions and advise regarding additional required analysis, if any. Environmental planning efforts will support the planned development of airport infrastructure, including projects identified in the 2021 Lake Chelan Airport Master Plan Update and shall comply with NEPA, FAA, and all other federal, state and local regulations and guidance.
